meta.name: Puzzle 05 — Contain the Chaos
meta.description: SOLO PUZZLE. An R-pentomino sits at the center. Left alone it will explode for hundreds of generations. Goal: place Eaters to contain the explosion so final alive count ≤ 12 after the simulation runs. Teaches that named tools can tame even the most chaotic seeds.
meta.rules: Solo mode. Prompt: 'Contain the specimen. Final alive count ≤ 12 cells. 2 moves.' Win check: final count.
questions: Is 2 eaters enough to contain an R-pent?
Is this too hard without trial and error?

moves.note: Player places first Eater in the NW quadrant to catch outgoing debris.
Player places second Eater in the SE quadrant, rotated 180° to face incoming debris from the opposite side.
